requirements.title: Controlled supported publication

source.excerpt: The protected GitLab tag pipeline is the only supported way to publish OpDev.

requirements.rationale: Bounded repository delivery/recovery mechanism; not qualification of a new release or authorization to publish.

criteria.expected: The supported publisher depends on every required quality, platform, package, evidence and signing step; allowed-failure and optional-edge bypasses are rejected, and publication requires a protected release tag.

source.excerpt: The automated recovery paths are bounded by the failure they address:

requirements.rationale: Bounded repository delivery/recovery mechanism; not qualification of a new release or authorization to publish.

criteria.expected: Retry after interrupted draft upload retains matching bytes, uploads only missing assets and publishes once; a conflicting existing digest fails without overwriting remote inventory.
